context: First reflash applied. Same bike, 4th gear pulls 14/15/16/17 + 5th gear pull. Comparing against iter_0 baseline.

afr_status.reason: Wideband channels now report 0.00 (was 5.10/rail-saturated pre-reflash). Different failure mode - channel disconnected vs sensor pegged. LC-2 likely unplugged during reflash and not reconnected. AFR feedback still cannot be used to validate this tune.

postreflash_pull_14.csv.note: Brief knock retard on front cyl (4 deg) cleared by next pull.

peak_tq_ftlb_avg.delta: -9.2 ftlb (curve flattened, peak moved up RPM)

peak_tq_rpm_band.note: Peak TQ RPM moved up roughly 500 rpm and got tighter

inj_duty_rear_max.delta: CRITICAL FIX: rear injector no longer maxed

ve_rear_minus_front_median.note: Front and rear VE tables now nearly equal. Rear-bias correction in old tune was reversed.

knock_retard.iter_1: one event 4 deg front + 2 deg rear on pull 14, then 0

cht_progression.note: Bike running hotter in this session - heat soak from sequential pulls

safety_findings.description: Rear injector duty dropped from 100-102% (saturated) to 67-76% across all post-reflash pulls. Tuning above 5500 RPM is now physically possible. Previous HIGH risk flag (injector_runout) is mitigated by the new tune for current RPM range; if pushing to redline 6200, monitor on next pulls.

VE Rear minus VE Front median collapsed from +10.4 to +1.0-1.4. The new tune has nearly identical front and rear VE tables. This either: (a) reflects the customer/dealer flattening rear-bias correction that the OEM tune embedded, or (b) the autotune did this. Without AFR feedback we cannot tell whether the new flat-VE tune fits the engine.

Pull 14 had 4 deg front + 2 deg rear knock retard for a brief moment near peak HP. Cleared on subsequent pulls. Could be a hot cycle, fuel quality, or genuine borderline timing. Repeat in next session and see if it returns at the same RPM/load cell.
CHT progression 189 -> 207 -> 208 across the session, peaking on the 5th-gear pull. Not yet at any halt threshold but the rear is taking heat. Add cool-down between pulls.

Wideband still not producing usable AFR data (now 0.00 instead of 5.10 - different mode but same blocker). Cannot validate that the new tune is putting actual fuel where commanded. Cannot do closed-loop tuning until LC-2 is reconnected and verified.

next_actions: Reconnect Innovate LC-2, verify warmup/power, retake 2-3 4th-gear WOT pulls so AFR can validate the new tune.
If knock event on pull 14 reappears, pull a few degrees of timing in the cell where it happened (around peak HP RPM).
Cool-down 60s between WOT pulls to keep CHT below 200 F.
Once AFR is back, decide: keep the flat VE Front=Rear approach, or restore some rear-cyl bias if AFR shows rear running leaner.
